description_en: Lists the entities for a specified robot. This operation returns only entity metadata, such as the entity type, name, creation time, and update time
description_zh: 查询指定机器人下的实体列表数据，仅返回每个实体的meta信息，如：实体类型、实体名称、创建时间、修改时间等
kebab_example: aliyun chatbot list-ds-entity --agent-key ac627989eb4f8a98ed05fd098bbae5_p_beebot_public --instance-id chatbot-cn-yjzbyrEvqd --keyword '实体' --entity-type synonyms_regex_system --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2022-04-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDSEntity

parameters.help_en: The key of the business space. If this parameter is not set, the default business space is used. You can find this key on the Business Management page of your main account
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间key，不设置则访问默认业务空间，key值在主账号业务管理页面获取
parameters.name: agent_key

parameters.help_en: A keyword to filter entities by name using a 'contains' match. Future releases will also support searching by entity member and synonym
parameters.help_zh: 筛选项，contains匹配，范围：实体名称（未来扩展：实体成员、同义词）
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The entity type. If you omit this parameter, all custom entities are returned
parameters.help_zh: 为空：全量自定义实体（默认）
parameters.name: entity_type

parameters.help_en: The current page number. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return per page. The default value is 10
parameters.name: page_size
